notes.title: Small update v1.0.1
notes.content:
By popular demand we added 2 small features ːsteamthumbsupː

[b]-Remove Censor Option
[/b]Now you can remove the censor blur from the nude skin from options menu.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rgaQlqF.jpg[/img]


[b]-Max FPS option
[/b]Due some comments we recieved regarding performance we added a max fps option to adjust GPU performance.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xNW3Xsf.png[/img]

We hope you are enjoying the game! 

See you on the next update,

Mitsuki team
